text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to advise Community Council concerning an application by the property owner for a site-specific Fence Exemption, pursuant to Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447- Fences. The property owner is seeking Community Council's permission to keep the existing rod iron fence which exceeds the permitted height.

North York Community Council: 1. Withdrew Item NY31.34 since the fence exemption is no longer required given that the applicant has advised that he is removing the fence in the front yard, which is the subject of the fence exemption application.
